name: Triptii Dimri
bio: Triptii Dimri is an Indian actress whose talent was discovered by Sajid Ali which gave her, her breakthrough role with the classic love story ‘Laila Majnu’ (2018) where she played the role of “Laila.” She was fascinated by the glamorous life since the start and thus, started her career as a model.
